Own the map before the first heatwave

The day the weather breaks, “AC repair near me” and “furnace repair” spike at once — and they fall on whichever company ranks first across a whole service area. A single map pin can’t show which neighbourhoods find you when the rush hits, so a rival banks the overflow. Eagle Eye scans the area on a grid and tracks it over time, so you see the demand shift coming and hold the top of the map through the season.

Be first when demand spikes

  • Service-area rank — a grid over every neighbourhood you serve, not one city-wide position.
  • Scheduled scans — run the grid through the season and watch rank move with the weather.
  • Demand alerts — hear it when LSOV falls or a rival takes the top 3 as the rush builds.
  • ATRP — where you’re off the map across the area, as a number that can move.

Start free: 10 scans, a free first scan of your own company up to 21 × 21, and credits that never expire — ready for the next season, not just this one. Catch the swing with scheduled scans — see the plans.

Three numbers, every scan

Three numbers a client remembers and a trend that proves your work paid off. Every scan rolls the whole grid into them — no spreadsheet, no hand-waving.

Local Share of Voice
LSOVLocal Share of Voice

How much of the whole grid finds the business near the top — one number for the entire map.

Average Rank, found
ARPAverage Rank, found

The mean position across only the points that return the business at all.

Average Total Rank
ATRPAverage Total Rank

The same average, counting every point that missed the business entirely — the honest one.

Questions, answered

How does Eagle Eye help an HVAC company rank?

It scans the service area on a grid and tracks it over time for “AC repair near me” and “furnace repair”, so you see the seasonal demand shift coming and hold the top of the map through the rush.

Can I track demand through a heatwave or cold snap?

Yes — run the grid on a schedule through the season and watch rank move with the weather, with alerts as the rush builds.

How do I measure where I’m off the map across the area?

ATRP turns every missing point into a number that can move, so the blank parts of the service area are measured.

Can I see which companies win the neighbourhoods I miss?

Eagle Eye draws a competitor map for every rival that outranks you — their rank at every point of the same grid — so you see exactly which competitor wins each block, not just that you place #5.

Is there a free scan to start?

A new organisation starts with 10 free scans, and your first scan of your own website is free at any size up to 21 × 21 — no card needed.
